title: silene glabellum
intro: Silene glabellum, commonly known as Evening Primrose or Evening Star, is a flowering plant species within the family Caryophyllaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and alleviating symptoms of menopause, as well as providing relief from menstrual cramps and other premenstrual symptoms. The therapeutic actions of Silene glabellum include its ability to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, making it a potential remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Silene glabellum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
